title: Integral boundary normalization with variable coefficient towers
statement: For ring-sheaf towers R and A, their system-ring map φ, ChernData c [def-sp-tower-class-chern], and a coefficient-unit map q, assume the existing ChernData.Normalized record for c and q. For every integer-to-shifted-units arrow f, the transported conjugated arrow [def-sfb-tower-underlying-arrow] satisfies IntegralBoundaryNormalization [def-sfb-integral-boundary-normalization], using the actual named positive Kummer boundary [def-sfb-positive-kummer-boundary]. Only the first two fields of the normalization record enter the proof; the scalar field is unused.

source.place: clause (2), evaluation gives the finite Kummer first Chern class; expanded SmoothPurityTowerClasses proof, steps 5--8

proof.text: In arbitrary categories, move the source-normalized generator across the adjunction using right naturality and cancellation of the source isomorphism. Apply left naturality to move the given arrow outside the adjunct, and replace the remaining adjunct by the target normalization. This proves that the actual underlyingSingleArrow equals composition with positiveExactBoundary. Specialize to c.reduction.model, its source and target normalizations, the actual Kummer complex and exactness, and the arbitrary integer-to-shifted-units arrow f. The two named concrete arrow constructions give the desired Fact equality.

proof_origin.place: clause (2), normalized integral quotient and positive Kummer boundary; proved by E5

theorem integralArrow_of_normalized (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    {T : Scheme.{u}}
    (R A : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.systemRing.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (fun n ↦ R.obj (op n))
        (fun n ↦ R.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) ⟶
      WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.systemRing.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (fun n ↦ A.obj (op n))
        (fun n ↦ A.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op))
    (c : ChernData l T R A φ)
    (q : coefficient T R ⟶
      (WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1} φ).obj (coefficient T A))
    (hc : ChernData.Normalized l T R A φ c q)
    (f : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab T) 0).obj (integers T) ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab T) 0).obj (units T))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) :
    IntegralBoundaryNormalization l R A φ c f
